entry.title: UniTO Working Group on Open Science

link.title: UniTO Working Group on Open Science

entry.content:
I have been officially appointed as an expert member of the Working Group on Open Science at the University of Turin. I have been appointed as an expert in “quantitative analysis of science, science policy and mapping of scientific systems”.

The Working Group supports the development of open science practices at the university, contributing to the drafting of institutional policies and to the implementation of the National Open Science Plan (part of the National Research Program 2021-2027). The Working Group includes researchers from a wide array of disciplines, from life sciences to archaeology, from computer science to physics.

I am particularly interested in open science and research evaluation and open data management.

entry.content:
Find here the poster I presented at the European Philosophy of Science Association’s conference in Groningen this year. It is co-authored with Lorenzo Gandolfi and Edoardo Fazzini.
